enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (2) vs.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures anti-meningococcal polysaccharide antibody isotypes/subclasses (IgG, IgM, IgG1, IgG2) in serum, whereas Record B measures cytokines (IL-6, TNF, IL-12p40) in cell supernatants.

flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures frequency of blood antibody-secreting cells in whole blood by the ASC marker set CD3− CD20− CD38hi CD27hi CD19+, whereas Record B measures dendritic-cell surface expression of CD80, CD83, HLA-DR, and CD86 in blood myeloid and monocyte-derived dendritic cells.
